business_summary: Mitsubishi Corporation engages in the global environment and energy, material solutions, metal resources, social infrastructure, mobility, food industry, SLC, and power solutions businesses in Japan and internationally. The Global Environmental Energy segment engages in the development and production of natural gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG), LPG, and petroleum products; and development of energy businesses. The Material Solutions segment is involved in sales transactions; and business investment and business development in material-related fields, including petrochemicals, basic chemicals, functional materials, carbon/ceramics, and steel products. The Mineral Resources segment engages in the investment and development of metal resources, such as copper, coking coal, iron ore, aluminum, lithium, and nickel; and supplies raw materials for steel and non-ferrous metals. The Urban Development & Infrastructure segment develops power generation, ships, aerospace, industrial machinery, energy infrastructure, and vinegar. The Mobility segment is involved in the automotive value chain business, including sales, sales financing, after-sales services for automobiles, and mobility service businesses; and mobility-related businesses. The Food industry segment sells food, fresh produce, consumer goods, and food ingredients. The S.L.C. segment is involved in C2B business. The Power Solutions segment engages in power generation, trading, and retail electricity, as well as power transmission and hydrogen energy development. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Mitsubishi Corporation은 일본 및 해외에서 글로벌 환경 및 에너지, 재료 솔루션, 금속 자원, 사회 인프라, 모빌리티, 식품 산업, SLC 및 전력 솔루션 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 글로벌 환경 에너지 부문은 천연가스, 액화천연가스(LNG), LPG, 석유 제품의 개발 및 생산에 종사합니다. 및 에너지 사업 개발. Material Solutions 부문은 판매 거래에 관여합니다. 석유화학, 기초화학, 기능성 소재, 탄소/세라믹, 철강제품 등 소재 관련 분야의 사업 투자 및 사업 개발을 하고 있습니다. 광물자원 부문은 구리, 원료탄, 철광석, 알루미늄, 리튬, 니켈과 같은 금속 자원의 투자 및 개발에 참여합니다. 철강 및 비철금속의 원료를 공급하고 있습니다. 도시 개발 및 인프라 부문은 발전, 선박, 항공우주, 산업 기계, 에너지 인프라 및 식초를 개발합니다. 모빌리티 부문은 자동차 판매, 판매금융, 애프터서비스, 모빌리티 서비스 등 자동차 가치사슬 사업을 영위하고 있습니다.
